source.title: Identifying Medical Diagnoses and Treatable Diseases by Image-Based Deep Learning
source.section: STAR Methods, printed e1, PDF page 12

source_reported_facts: Retrospective anterior-posterior chest radiographs from children aged one to five at Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center, obtained during routine care.
Unreadable or low-quality scans were excluded; two expert physicians graded diagnoses and a third checked the evaluation set.
current_analysis_limits: These are source-author statements, not new clinical verification by this project.
The reanalysis inherits directory labels and does not independently adjudicate diagnosis.
Individual demographics, microbiological evidence and verified clinical patient IDs were not available to this analysis.
The source paper's OCT-specific labeling tiers and patient-separation statements must not be transferred to the chest-radiograph cohort.
Original study ethics statements do not establish approval or exemption for this reanalysis.
artifact_policy: The source PDF is retained locally for review and excluded from the source release.
